# Experimental interface API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

The point where hardware meets the animal or tissue, such as an implanted probe, a cranial window or a fiber.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/experimentalinterface/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/modules/experimentalinterface/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `experimentalinterface` (detail, create, update), `experimentalinterfaces` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `subject.projects` or `specimen_set.projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Schema payload:** `type` selects a [ExperimentalInterface type](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/); send its fields in `details`. `type_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.
- **Schema payload:** `coordinates` selects a [Coordinates type](/api/schemas/coordinates/); send its fields in `coordinates_json`. `coordinates_schema_version` is set by the server; do not send it.
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`materialusage`](/api/modules/materialusage/) records

Form-only inputs (sent on create or update, not returned in responses):

- `target_type` **[required]**. Choices: `subject`, `specimen_set`. Choose whether this interface targets an in-vivo subject or an ex-vivo specimen set.

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 255 characters |
| `notes` | string; max 500 characters; nullable |
| `type` | one of the [ExperimentalInterface types](/api/schemas/experimentalinterface/) **[required]** |
| `persistence` | one of `chronic`, `session`, `transient` **[required]** |
| `subject` | [`subject`](/api/stem/subject/) id; nullable; nestable |
| `specimen_set` | [`specimenset`](/api/stem/specimenset/) id; nullable; nestable |
| `target_specimens` | list of [`specimen`](/api/stem/specimen/) ids. Specific specimens within the specimen set targeted by this interface. Leave empty when the interface applies to the whole specimen set. |
| `material_usages` | list of [`materialusage`](/api/modules/materialusage/) ids **[read-only]** |
| `materials` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `equipment` | list of [`equipment`](/api/modules/equipment/) ids |
| `target_regions` | list of [`anatomicalregion`](/api/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/) ids; nestable |
| `coordinates` | one of the [Coordinates types](/api/schemas/coordinates/) **[required]**; nullable |
| `coordinates_json` | JSON object; nullable |
| `coordinates_schema_version` | string **[set by the server]**; max 20 characters |
| `details` | JSON object |
| `type_schema_version` | string **[set by the server]** |
| `installed_at` | datetime; nullable |
| `removed_at` | datetime; nullable |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/experimentalinterface/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('experimentalinterface', load_all=True)
records = resp['experimentalinterfaces']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('experimentalinterface', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.experimentalinterfaces;
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/experimentalinterface/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('experimentalinterface', data={"name": "Experimental interface 1", "type": "AuditoryStimulator", "persistence": "chronic", "coordinates": "Stereotaxic_BregmaBrainSurface", "details": {"...": "see the schema of the selected type"}, "coordinates_json": {"...": "the fields of the selected Coordinates type"}, "target_type": "subject", "subject": "<subject-id>"})
record = resp.json()['experimentalinterface']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Experimental interface 1', 'type', 'AuditoryStimulator', 'persistence', 'chronic', 'coordinates', 'Stereotaxic_BregmaBrainSurface', 'details', struct(), 'coordinates_json', struct(), 'target_type', 'subject', 'subject', '<subject-id>'), 'experimentalinterface');  % struct() stands for the fields of the selected type
record = created.experimentalinterface;
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/experimentalinterface/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('experimentalinterface', id='<id>', data={"name": "Experimental interface 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Experimental interface 1 (renamed)'), 'experimentalinterface', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/experimentalinterface/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('experimentalinterface', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'experimentalinterface');
```

## Custom actions

| Action | Request |
|:-------|:--------|
| `apply_material_template` | POST `/api/private/modules/experimentalinterface/<id>/apply-material-template/` |
| `material_options` | GET `/api/private/modules/experimentalinterface/material-options/` |
| `materials` | GET, PUT `/api/private/modules/experimentalinterface/<id>/materials/` |

`materials` returns the ordered material usage rows that describe what the interface is made of; `PUT` replaces them as a whole. `apply-material-template` copies the rows of a material usage template. `material-options` lists the material roles and allowed sources of an interface type (`?type=<Type>`).

## Data model

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Experimental interface data model page](/datamodel/modules/experimentalinterface/).
